description_en: Creates tag-resource relationships to add user tags to resources
description_zh: 创建标签资源关系，即可为资源创建用户标签
kebab_example: aliyun oos tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-ids key=example-string --resource-type template --tags key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The list of resource IDs of the cloud resources for which you want to modify the resource group. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs.

If ResourceType is set to template, set ResourceIds to ["TemplateName1","TemplateName2"].

If ResourceType is set to parameter, set ResourceIds to ["Name1","Name2"].

If ResourceType is set to secretparameter, set ResourceIds to ["Name1","Name2"].
If ResourceType is set to stateconfiguration, set ResourceIds to ["StateConfigurationId1","StateConfigurationId2"].
If ResourceType is set to application, set ResourceIds to ["Name1","Name2"]
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud resource for which you want to modify the resource group. Valid values:

template: template.
parameter: parameter.
secretparameter: encrypted parameter.
stateconfiguration: desired state configuration.
application: application
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：

template: 模板。
parameter: 参数。
secretparameter: 加密参数。
stateconfiguration: 终态配置。
application: 应用
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The key-value mapping of tags. You can specify 1 to 20 key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 标签键值映射，键值对数量限制为1至20
parameters.name: tags
